subject.theme: The last seaside tram in a rainstorm
subject.tram: One small, single-car modern tram traveling away on rails embedded in a stone-paved street
subject.pedestrians: Three umbrella-carrying pedestrians spaced along the inland side of the street

composition.route: A stone-paved harbor street on solid ground narrows diagonally from the lower right toward the middle left
composition.space: A broad, uninterrupted harbor lies below the stone seawall, with a low blue-gray silhouette on the far shore

style.medium: Color woodblock print, fine ink outlines, flat color shapes, subtle print grain and warm ivory paper
style.rain: Two sets of long, fine rain lines cross the sky, water and foreground. The second set is sparser and slightly differently angled
style.palette: Charcoal indigo fading to blue-gray in the sky, muted teal harbor water, pale gray ochre on the near shore, and amber concentrated in the tram windows
style.detail: Define the tram, umbrellas, tracks and seawall. Simplify the distant shore
